visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a stainless steel commercial kitchen with a gas stove burning with blue flames. A hand wearing a black sleeve uses yellow handled tongs to lift a brown clay pot lid from a simmering pot. (2) A close-up shot shows a white bowl filled with thin noodles being lifted by black chopsticks, glistening with a dark soy-based sauce. (3) A chef's hands are shown at a stainless steel station, meticulously folding a thin white dough wrapper into a wonton shape over a container of filling. (4) Sliced pan-fried pork chops are presented on top of a bed of noodles; a pair of chopsticks lifts one thick slice to reveal the tender, light-colored meat inside. (5) A small white dish pours dark red chili oil and crispy shallots over a pile of noodles, which are then tossed vigorously with chopsticks. (6) A hand lifts the lid off a clay pot to reveal steaming white rice topped with several large, split prawns and chopped green onions. Dark sauce is then drizzled from a small white pitcher onto the prawns. (7) A bowl of wontons sits in a pool of red chili oil, topped with diced chilies and green onions; chopsticks pick up one wonton to show its plump filling. (8) Multiple bamboo steamers are stacked, with thick steam rising from between them. A lid is lifted to reveal delicate translucent dumplings topped with black truffle. (9) Golden-brown pan-fried radish cakes are shown on a white plate; one piece is dipped into a small dish of red sweet chili sauce. (10) Sliced shrimp rice rolls are presented, showing whole pink shrimp inside a translucent skin. (11) A fried golden ball is broken apart to show a liquid yellow custard filling flowing out. (12) Pan-fried sticky rice patties with an egg coating are sliced to reveal a savory meat and mushroom center. (13) Crispy golden spring rolls are displayed, with one cut open to show a vibrant green spinach and cheese filling. (14) The camera pans across the restaurant interior featuring light wood shelving and a clean dining area, then cuts to the exterior entrance showing the brand name '好事泰'.

By emphasizing the professional background of the chef and providing sensory close-ups of the food, it seeks to attract diners to its Kaohsiung location.
